caption: One CI run on a single clock: install 40 s, test 25 s, build 30 s, deploy 15 s, ending at 110 s. A failing test stops the run at 65 s, before any image is built; the same work by hand takes 1200 s, so 1090 s is saved.

spec.aria: A timeline of one CI run on a seconds axis: install from 0 to 40, test from 40 to 65, build from 65 to 95, and deploy from 95 to 110, so the run ends at 110 seconds.
